_comment: Copy this file to cesium_config.json and fill in your values. config/*.json (except *.example.json) is gitignored.
_comment_tokens: Two ion tokens. WRITE (assets:write) is used by --stage upload only and is never published. VIEWER must be a separate READ-ONLY token (assets:read); it is written into manifest.json for the browser.
_comment_server_url: Leave empty for relative URLs (works when viewers+data are co-hosted). Set to full URL like 'http://163.220.179.199/neoreef' when data is on a different origin.
_comment_positions: 3D model placement. Defaults to survey_positions.json next to this file; see survey_positions.example.json.
_comment_extras: EXTRA_ORTHOS: [{path, survey_name, ortho_type}]. EXTRA_3D_MODELS: [{path, survey_name, model_type, format, position}]. known_ion_assets: {id -> ion asset id} for assets uploaded by hand. BASE_ION_3DTILES_ASSET: e.g. 2275207 for Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles.
